name.ja: HG 1/144 デストロイガンダム

description.ja: TVアニメ『機動戦士ガンダムSEED DESTINY』より、巨大可変MS「デストロイガンダム」がHGシリーズで立体化！
description.en: From the TV anime "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED DESTINY ", the giant variable MS " Destroy Gundam" is now three-dimensional in the HG series!

description.ja: ■全高約390mm。迫力のサイズでありながらMA形態への変形が可能。
description.en: • Overall height approximately 390mm. Despite its impressive size, it can transform into MA form.

description.ja: ■ビッグスケールならではの緻密なモールド表現。
description.en: • Precise mold expression unique to Big Scale.

description.ja: ■本体随所に設けられた関節機構がダイナミックなポージングに対応。
description.en: • Joint mechanisms installed throughout the main body support dynamic posing.

description.ja: ■頭部、腕部、脚部、背面など各所にMS/MAそれぞれの形態の安定性を向上させるロック機構を採用。
description.en: • Locking mechanisms are used in various parts such as the head, arms, legs, and back to improve the stability of each MS/MA form.

description.ja: ■五指は各関節で可動し、表情付けが可能。人差し指から小指はランナーに付いた状態で組み立てが可能。
description.en: • The five fingers can move at each joint and express expressions. Assembly is possible with the index finger to little finger attached to the runner.

description.ja: ■全長約260mmの大型ビームエフェクトが付属。偏光成形の採用により、光源の角度による色調の変化が楽しめる。
description.en: • Comes with a large beam effect with a total length of approximately 260mm. By using polarized light molding, you can enjoy the change in color tone depending on the angle of the light source.

description.ja: ■腕部は別売りのアクションベースに接続可能。
description.en: • The arms can be connected to an action base (sold separately).
